# MLOps v3

MLOps v3 Accelerator - a PowerShell module (Deploy-MLOpsAccelerator) that turns one inputs file into bootstrap, IaC (Terraform or Bicep on Azure Verified Modules), CI/CD (GitHub or Azure DevOps) and an Azure Machine Learning workload across 11 scenarios.

- [MLOps v3 Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pgabriel-01/mlops-v3/refs/heads/main/docs/_index.md)
